_readme: This is the ONLY file you need to edit to retune the job machine. Change a number, save, done.

search._note: Each title below becomes its own Indeed search. Add or remove freely.

hard_filters._note: A job failing ANY of these is dropped before it costs a detail lookup. No judgement calls.
hard_filters._salary_unknown_note: 'keep' = senior roles often hide comp; don't lose them. Set to 'drop' to be strict.
hard_filters._exclude_companies_note: Add any employer you never want to see. Current employer NATIVO belongs here if this search is confidential.

scoring._note: Weights must total 100. See references/scoring.md for what each one means.
scoring._draft_threshold_note: Only jobs scoring at or above this get a written application. Raise it to get fewer, better packages.

industries._note: Used by industry_match scoring. Pulled from the resume's actual track record.

application._note: Controls what the machine is permitted to do without asking. See SKILL.md Step 6.
application._auto_submit_note: MASTER SWITCH. Stays false until a real send capability exists AND Raquel flips it. When false, every application stops at a saved draft.
application._channels_note: Only ever add a channel where programmatic submission is explicitly permitted by that service. Job-board portals (Indeed, LinkedIn, Workday, Greenhouse UI) are NOT eligible - automating those violates their terms and gets the account banned.
application._cap_note: Hard ceiling per run. Executive search is won on precision, not volume.
